security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline backticks, documentation links, and placeholder secret names. The confirmed issue is the curl-to-bash installer pattern in SKILL.md and SKILL.toon, which executes remote code without verification. No prompt injection attempt or credential exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Remove curl piped to bash. Prefer npm installation, a pinned release artifact, or a checksum-verified download with clear review steps.
Tell users to review commands before execution, confirm target projects, and avoid automatic deployment from agent sessions.
Keep placeholders for API keys, recommend managed secrets for production, and warn against logging or committing real values.

content.value_statement: Developers need clear patterns for production AI flows, agents, RAG, and deployment. This skill provides Genkit setup, examples, commands, and deployment guidance for Firebase and Cloud Run.
actual_capabilities: Explains Genkit setup for TypeScript projects and model plugins.
Shows type-safe flow definitions with Zod input and output schemas.
Covers streaming responses, tool calling, and multi-agent flow patterns.
Describes RAG setup with local vector stores and retrieval flows.
Includes deployment patterns for Firebase Functions, Express, and Cloud Run.
Lists Genkit CLI commands for running, testing, tracing, and evaluation.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not install dependencies by itself.
Examples need project-specific credentials, model choices, and cloud settings.
Commands can change local or cloud resources when a user runs them.
It does not replace current Genkit, Firebase, or provider documentation.

use_cases.title: Create a typed AI endpoint
use_cases.description: Build a Genkit flow with validated inputs, structured outputs, and traceable execution.

use_cases.title: Prototype a retrieval assistant
use_cases.description: Combine vector retrieval, grounding instructions, and a Genkit flow for question answering.

use_cases.title: Prepare cloud deployment
use_cases.description: Map a working local flow to Firebase Functions, Express, or Cloud Run deployment patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Create a starter flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Genkit project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Firebase Genkit TypeScript flow for <task>. Include input fields, output shape, and local test steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add streaming output
prompt_templates.prompt: Update my Genkit flow to stream progress for <use case>. Explain the stream schema, final output, and client handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design a tool-calling agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Genkit agent for <goal> using tools for <tool list>. Include schemas, tool behavior, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a RAG deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Genkit RAG pipeline for <content source>. Cover indexing, retrieval, grounding, evaluation, secrets, and Firebase or Cloud Run deployment.

output_examples.input: Create a starter Genkit flow for summarizing support tickets.
output_examples.output: A concise implementation plan with fields for ticket text, priority, summary, and next action, plus local test commands.

output_examples.input: Design a RAG assistant for product documentation.
output_examples.output: A pipeline outline covering document indexing, retrieval limits, grounded answer rules, evaluation inputs, and deployment choices.

output_examples.input: Prepare my flow for Cloud Run deployment.
output_examples.output: A deployment checklist covering server handler setup, environment variables, region choice, and post-deploy verification.

best_practices: Define schemas for every flow input and output before adding model calls.
Use secret managers or environment variables for provider keys, and avoid logging secret values.
Test flows in the Genkit Developer UI before deploying them to shared environments.
anti_patterns: Do not run installation or deployment commands without reviewing the command and target environment.
Do not hardcode API keys, project IDs, or private endpoints into shared examples.
Do not let agent tools call external services without validation, timeouts, and clear user consent.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build Firebase Genkit flows, agents, RAG pipelines, streaming responses, and deployment plans.

faq.question: Does it support model providers beyond Gemini?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill references Google AI, Vertex AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, and other Genkit plugins.

faq.question: Can it deploy code for me automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides deployment guidance and commands, but users should review and run commands deliberately.

faq.question: Is it useful for RAG applications?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes retrieval, vector store, grounding, and evaluation guidance for Genkit RAG flows.

faq.question: How should API keys be handled?
faq.answer: Use environment variables or managed secrets. Never place real API keys in source code or prompts.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
